input_check, part 1: keep a copy of the provided estimation and hold-out tables
steps.command: rm -rf provided_estimation provided_holdout && cp -R estimation provided_estimation && cp -R holdout provided_holdout

steps.what: Build the estimation and hold-out tables from the inputs (same calls as the original run; asserts that the LL at the final estimates is reproduced on both halves)
input_check, part 2: compare the rebuilt tables with the provided ones (rows, column sums, largest difference); must print ALL TABLES MATCH
Log-likelihood at the article coefficients (no estimation, nothing written)
Biogeme estimation, start values = article estimates
Compare the estimates with the article (reference_estimates.csv)

notes: Full choice set (no sampling): all zones with enrolment of the segment; an alternative is available when it has enrolment of the student's own band.

Location mixture: the survey home and school locations can each spread over several model zones (weights w_h, w_c). L_n = sum_h sum_c w_h w_c exp(V_hc) / sum_j av_hj exp(V_hj), written with Biogeme's WeightedLogSumExp (exact).
Size term mu ln(sum_k exp(g_k) N_k + 1e-12) with the first enrolment component as reference (weight 1), as in the original estimator.
Variables in single precision, as the original estimator computes them (t, ln(1+t), shares).

Own-race share: share of the zone's enrolment of the student's band that is of the student's race (white non-Hispanic, Black non-Hispanic, Hispanic, other); student race from the RTS person file (two race codings by region, identified by home county). In SILO the share is recomputed every simulated year from the assigned students. It is a composition effect: preference, information, transport and history are not separable. The same model without it is the comparison: hold-out LL -1,227.63 against -1,207.53.
Charter-or-magnet share: share of the zone's enrolment of the band in public charter (CCD 2024-25 directory) or magnet (CCD 2017-18 characteristics) schools.

Private enrolment enters the size term with weight 1 (log weight fixed at 0; p = 0.37 when estimated). School quality was tested and not kept: with the private log weight free it is 0.203 (t 3.2) but the BIC is 0.4 above the model without it.
The hold-out half was also used in the specification search, so its fit is not an independent test (specification search in model/README.md).
The data are stored in long format (students, alternatives, candidates); the script makes the wide table itself.

Memory: the estimation compiles the analytical Hessian of the whole expression (JAX). Options that change only how derivatives are computed, not the model (not tested here): in ../output/biogeme.toml set analytical_hessian_mode = "chunked" (with a smaller hessian_memory_fraction), or calculating_second_derivatives = "finite_differences". Run the school models alone, with the Java jobs stopped.
Steps with output_provided = true can be skipped: their results are in input/data or 00_shared_data. Upstream project stages were not re-run for this package; their runtimes are not measured.
Measured here (48 GB): --check 191 s, 6.6 GB; build 1 s, 1.0 GB; estimation NOT run (expect hours and more memory than the check).
Environment: Biogeme scripts and package build scripts run with ~/.venvs/biogeme/bin/python (Biogeme 3.3.5); project scripts with /opt/homebrew/anaconda3/bin/python3 (needs geopandas).
